description: Design decision required before T-016 can be implemented. Resolve: (1) what event triggers multi-lens analysis — every message is too expensive, explicit demand is just "ask Claude," so what's the right inflection point? Candidates: start of decision mode, specific phrasing patterns, manual tool invocation, N exchanges into decision mode. (2) Frequency cap per session/topic. (3) Output disposition — inline, observation, session-end summary. (4) Minimum lens set. (5) Cost acceptance at intended trigger rate. This is a design/discussion ticket, not an implementation ticket.
title: Design: multi-lens trigger contract — when does reasoning analysis add value?
